author: petr1petr
body:
find active kingdom - and talk to more experienced kingdom mates.

upgrade your items when you sleep - you dont need high lvl..

weapon is the most important thing.

learn to use equipment tabs - default (world) should be +view equips, so that you can see more things around you - start with lanterns from shop, Gazing staff in each hand..

you can also go to youtube, find Shabbash and watch his guides - some are a bit outdated, but still worth watching - he can explain things really well.

have fun..

author: MyuFoxy
body:
I prefer scrolls or dual wielding staffs over shields as druid. Anything to up mag. My goal is to kill on the first spell or die. For stronger opponents I'll hit them with a sleep dart, then Sorrow II. 

The rules flip on their head when playing summoner. Mag hasn't been as useful as turtling up and letting summons do all the fighting. You should have that class for free pretty soon if not already by going down the magic path. It's very strong against raids and dungeons.

I would also probably switch the specialization to something with more spell slots over berserker. The way I used druid was having a spell for many different damage types to take advantage of weaknesses to one shot as much as I could.
